_PAGE_FILTER_VALUE_BY_CONDITION_ARGUMENT: The value that is checked by conditions and can be used in functions, expressions, and templates.
An ordered list of condition objects. The first matching condition defines the returned value.
A function or JavaScript expression string that receives the current value and decides whether the condition matches.
A static value or function returned when the condition matches.
A JavaScript template string used when the condition matches. The current value is available as value.
A static value or function returned when no condition matches.
A JavaScript template string returned when no condition matches. The current value is available as value.
_PAGE_FILTER_VALUE_BY_CONDITION_DESCRIPT: The function filterValueByCondition returns a result based on the first matching condition. Conditions can be functions or JavaScript expression strings. Results can be static values, functions, or template strings.
_PAGE_FILTER_VALUE_BY_CONDITION_SECURITY: String expressions and templates are executed as JavaScript. Use them only with trusted configuration and never with unchecked user input.
